lines.text: Twenty-four years ago, a man scored a goal after ten seconds. Ten seconds. Nobody has beaten it since.
The fastest goal in World Cup history. And tonight, the ghost who scored it is watching.
Last time, we predicted Scotland and Morocco would fight out a goalless draw.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends, episode thirty-four. Turkey... versus Paraguay.
Fire against steel. Turkish flair against Paraguayan grit. And stay with me — because one of these nations is built on a miracle of speed.
Two proud nations, one place to fight for. Tonight, they collide.
First, the history. And it is true. The two thousand two World Cup, the third-place playoff.
Turkey kick off. Eleven seconds later, Hakan Sukur has scored.
Ten-point-eight seconds — the fastest goal the World Cup has ever seen. A record still standing, twenty-four years on.
Turkey finished third in the world that summer. A golden night a whole nation still dreams about.
And tonight, a new generation wants a golden night of its own.
Now meet Paraguay. A nation that does not flinch, forged in the fire of South American football.
In two thousand ten, they reached a World Cup quarterfinal — so close to the last four.
They defend like their lives depend on it. And on the break, they can punish anyone.
Two teams who have fought for every inch of this journey.
One built on flair. One built on steel. Tonight, something has to give.
Now, Turkey. Arda Guler — the young maestro they call the Turkish Messi, a left foot that bends geometry.
Hakan Calhanoglu conducts from deep. Kenan Yildiz, Kerem Akturkoglu, and Baris Alper Yilmaz bring the cutting edge.
Turkish fire — fast, fearless, and full of belief.
And across from them — Paraguay. Gustavo Gomez, a centre-back of pure granite, who will not be moved.
Julio Enciso carries the magic. Miguel Almiron the speed. Diego Gomez and Omar Alderete, the spine.
So here is the duel. Turkish artistry... against the most stubborn defence in South America.
Our prediction — built on Guler's genius, and on a Paraguay side that never knows when it is beaten. Watch.
The twenty-eighth minute. Calhanoglu slides it through, and Arda Guler curls it into the far corner. One-nil, Turkey.
But Paraguay do not break. They counter — Almiron flies, and Julio Enciso finishes. One-all.
The Houston night holds its breath. Gomez throws his body at everything. Paraguay will not fold.
Then, the winner. A set-piece, and Kenan Yildiz rises to head it home. Two-one, Turkey.
Two-one at the whistle, in our story. Turkish fire edges Paraguayan steel — but only just.
Do you agree? Comment TURKEY if the flair wins it. Comment PARAGUAY if the steel holds.
And that ghost in the stands? Legend number thirty-four: the Eleven-Second Ghost.
He scored before most fans had found their seats — and no one has done it faster since. Collect him inside the game.
Which brings us to you. At WorldCup twenty-six dot world, pick three of the forty-eight nations — and every goal they score, scores for you.
Free to play, no prizes. Like, share, subscribe — the legends are only beginning.
